notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

boot.failedDescription: The server did not answer. Check your connection, then try again. You are still signed in.

validation.passwordTooWeak: Choose a stronger password — longer, and not a common word or pattern.

errors.locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.signInFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.
errors.totpFailed: That code did not work. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
errors.keyGenerationFailed: Your keys could not be created on this device. Try again.

login.title: Sign in to Kutup
login.description: Your files and messages are unlocked on this device.
login.totpDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

newKeys.generatingDescription: This takes a few seconds and happens only on this device.
newKeys.passwordNotice: Kutup never sees your password. If you forget it, only your recovery phrase can get you back in.

recoveryPhrase.title: Your recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.description: 24 words that can restore your account if you forget your password.
recoveryPhrase.warning: This phrase is shown once. Nobody — not even your server's administrator — can recover your files without it or your password.
recoveryPhrase.fileHeader: Kutup recovery phrase for {{email}}. Keep this private and offline.
recoveryPhrase.saved: I have saved my recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.confirmDescription: Prove you saved it by entering three of its words.
recoveryPhrase.confirmHint: Type the words at these positions.
recoveryPhrase.mismatch: One or more words do not match. Check your saved phrase.

register.title: Create your Kutup account
register.description: Your keys are created on this device and never leave it unencrypted.
register.usernameHint: How people find you in Chat.
register.closedDescription: This server does not accept new accounts. Ask its administrator for one.
register.settingsUnavailable: The server's registration settings could not be read; it may refuse the account.

firstLogin.title: Finish setting up your account
firstLogin.description: An administrator created {{email}} for you. Choose your own password to create your encryption keys.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.description: Use your 24-word recovery phrase to choose a new password.
recover.phraseHint: The 24 words, in order, separated by spaces. Numbering is ignored.
recover.phraseInvalid: That is not a valid recovery phrase — check each word.
recover.signsOutEverywhere: Every device and app signed in to this account will be signed out.
recover.failed: Recovery failed. Check the email and the phrase.
recover.doneDescription: Sign in with your new password. Your files and messages are intact.

authorize.title: Opening {{app}}
authorize.failed: The app could not be opened. Try again from the app.
authorize.invalidDescription: This link asks for an app Kutup does not have.

launcher.title: Welcome, {{name}}
launcher.description: Pick up where you left off.
launcher.drive: Files, notes, documents and whiteboards, end-to-end encrypted.
launcher.chat: Private conversations and groups across Kutup servers.

account.title: Account
account.description: Who you are on this server, and how much space you use.
account.colourDescription: Your cursor and highlight colour when editing documents with others.
account.colourFailed: The colour could not be saved.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your sign-in and know how to get back in.
security.twoFactorDescription: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when signing in with a password.
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
security.verifyFailed: That code did not work. Enter the current code.
security.disableWarning: Your password alone will then be enough to sign in.
security.disableFailed: Two-factor authentication could not be turned off.
security.recoveryDescription: The 24 words shown when your account was created.
security.recoveryNote: Your recovery phrase is the only way to reset a forgotten password. Kutup does not store it and cannot show it again — keep your saved copy somewhere safe and offline.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Every place your account is signed in. Ending a sign-in there takes effect immediately.
sessions.endDescription: It will need to sign in again. Anything it was uploading stops.
sessions.endFailed: The session could not be ended.
sessions.endOthersDescription_one: {{count}} other sign-in will end. This device stays signed in.
sessions.endOthersDescription_other: {{count}} other sign-ins will end. This device stays signed in.

devices.title: Editor devices
devices.description: Each browser that edits documents with others signs its changes with its own key. Revoke a device you no longer use.
devices.revokeDescription: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign edits, and its open editing sessions close.
devices.revokeFailed: The device could not be revoked.
devices.emptyDescription: A device appears here the first time it opens a shared document.

admin.forbidden: Your account cannot open administration pages.
